hooks.command: d=$(mktemp -d) && d=$(cd "$d" && pwd -P) && if git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" archive -o "$d/scripts.tar" origin/main scripts && tar -xf "$d/scripts.tar" -C "$d"; then node "$d/scripts/hooks/guard.mjs"; s=$?; else echo "The guard could not read scripts/ from origin/main, so nothing was judged and nothing is allowed — hooks run the main copy, never this checkout's. docs/guidelines.md §5." >&2; s=2; fi; rm -rf "$d"; exit $s
